Execute only this independent PaperOrchestra invocation. Do not delegate or run the whole pipeline. You are an already dispatched role worker; model selection is complete. Do not invoke the PaperOrchestra setup flow or ask which model to use. Use only the supplied task inputs; return its requested output format verbatim. Do not read other invocation folders. Do not write workspace files.


            Find 10-15 highly relevant, influential academic papers matching the search task. Do not force results; only return strictly relevant papers.
            
            SEARCH TASK: "intercept correction" "systematic offset" "limitations"
            CONTEXT FOR TASK: Mission: Find specialized papers and technical reports on adding a scalar offset to an otherwise fixed predictor, including recent relevant work published by 2026-11. Identify their assumptions and estimation protocols for conceptual context. Do not propose additional methods to beat or imply that any external method was evaluated.. Hypothesis: The supplied baseline has no added intercept and therefore leaves the constant residual 3 on every supplied observation. A scalar correction changes only this offset; the inputs provide no evidence about correcting other residual patterns or other observations.
            BROADER PROJECT PROBLEM: The supplied fixed predictor 2x omits the constant offset in the five targets y=2x+3. The teaching problem is to explain the resulting residuals, their mean correction, and the limits of evaluating that correction on the same five observations. This is an exposition objective, not an established research gap or novel algorithm.
            CUTOFF DATE: Published BEFORE 2026-11
            
            INSTRUCTIONS:
            1. Use Google Search to find REAL papers (ArXiv, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).
            2. Only return papers published in top-tier conferences or journals, or highly-cited works, or the exact state-of-the-art relevant to the task.

            YOU MUST return the results in json format (```json content```) following this schema:
            {'$defs': {'CandidatePaper': {'properties': {'title': {'title': 'Title', 'type': 'string'}, 'year': {'title': 'Year', 'type': 'integer'}, 'reason': {'title': 'Reason', 'type': 'string'}}, 'required': ['title', 'year', 'reason'], 'title': 'CandidatePaper', 'type': 'object'}}, 'properties': {'section_name': {'title': 'Section Name', 'type': 'string'}, 'candidates': {'items': {'$ref': '#/$defs/CandidatePaper'}, 'title': 'Candidates', 'type': 'array'}}, 'required': ['section_name', 'candidates'], 'title': 'DiscoveryResult', 'type': 'object'}
